problem: _in_window ignores its key argument and always passes "" to the reference method, so every key shares the single bucket self._accepted[""] and one client's traffic uses up the limit and changes remaining/retry_after for every other client.

The production limiter now imports reference_impl and calls its private _in_window on an instance of a different class, so it works only because both classes use the same attribute names, fails at import if reference_impl is not deployed, and makes any comparison against the reference compare the window logic with itself.
The core window logic was rewritten with no tests anywhere in the repo, so the per-key isolation break in F1 went uncaught; nothing checks two keys or the boundary case now == t + window.
